threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of just the 'train'—everyone else knows it's just the East London line you hop on to go anywhere.
Caught a guy on the night bus in Brixton last week trying to convince a group he could spot UFOs from the top deck. Never laughed so hard.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the corner bakery started offering vegan kebab and I overheard two grannies arguing about the best spot for smoothies. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sip coffee while watching a spontaneous street performance of real-life breakdancing in the park on a Tuesday afternoon.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows the exact moment to sprint through the Civic Center Muni platform to avoid the dog delays. Tourists just stand there.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the bus today. A guy was teaching his parrot to squawk ‘Next stop!’ right on the corner of Turk and Jones. Muni never ceases to surprise.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but the real vibe is in the little plazas where locals gather over vermut, not just selfies.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they still ask for 'tapas' at a cocktail bar instead of 'pica-pica' – locals know it’s all about sharing, not just ordering.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 15 minutes to the Tube is a reasonable walk; locals know that's just a warm-up for the wait at the platform.
Caught the 345 last night, bus driver treated it like a go-kart race. Also, saw a guy serenading a sleeping passenger with a ukulele. Classic Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a toddler calmly feeding pigeons while a group of skaters smuggled in beers from the kiosk. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar in an old butcher shop that serves vegan currywurst alongside craft beer. It’s a wild blend of past and present.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they instinctively duck under the BART tracks at Civic Center, avoiding the smoke and chaos like it’s just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni stuck at Civic Center yesterday—dog on the tracks while a guy recited Shakespeare. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume all the street performers are locals, but many come from outside just to capitalize on our numerous festivals.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at how to find the 'actual' bus stops in Gràcia — they always stand near the wrong intersections.
